_comment: Copy this file to local_paths.json (which is gitignored) and edit for your machine. See README section 'Multi-user on one tablet' for the setup script and permissions model. The 'active_profile' key picks which block below is applied at import time; env vars (DDB_DATABASE_URL, DDB_DATA_DIR) still win over both.

local._comment: Single-user dev install. Nulls fall through to the in-repo defaults (ddb.sqlite3 + ./data/ under the checkout). Leave as-is if you just want one machine, one user.

shared_tablet._comment: Shared lab tablet. Point both keys at /srv/ddb/ (created by scripts/setup_shared_sqlite.sh). Every OS user in the 'ddb' group can read/write; the DDB user identity is derived from the Linux username at launch.
